THREE LAYERS / LIVE CANVAS
Visible layers

Find the depth.

Move your cursor to shift the three layers. Scroll or swipe to move through them. Far stars travel slowly; near stars and outlined triangles travel faster.

Use ← → to look around, ↑ ↓ to scroll, P to pause the drift, H to hide controls, and F for full screen. Depth amplifies the separation; checkboxes let you isolate a layer.

At 1× depth and drift, the layer speeds match tandavacult.com. With reduced motion enabled, drift, twinkling, cursor tracking, and triangle animation are disabled; scrolling still reveals the layers.
